basic_profile.headline: Founder @ Bild AI - AI for Blueprint Understanding.
basic_profile.name: Puneet Sukhija
basic_profile.summary:
Building the future of construction at Bild AI. After 7 years in the trenches of an industry plagued by inefficiency, I'm leveraging technology to break through the bottlenecks that have historically slowed us down. While construction timelines keep extending, we're creating AI solutions that reverse this trend, bringing speed, precision, and innovation to an industry ready for transformation. Join me as we rebuild the way we build starting with Takeoffs! 

I've consistently transformed ideas into tangible ventures. My passion for building started early - launching my first business while still in elementary school and continuing to develop multiple successful initiatives since then.

current.company_description: Bild AI automates Division 8 estimating — doors, frames, and hardware — end to end. Bild AI reads blueprints and specs, generates opening (door) schedules automatically, prices the bid, and exports it directly into the ERPs Division 8 shops already run on, including Comsense, Avaware, and ProTech.Division 8 estimating is the brutal trifecta of nitty-gritty details, where typos cost hundreds of thousands, and timelines are tight. Thousands of pages of specs, hardware sets cross-referenced by hand, and a single missed opening that can sink a bid's margin. Bild AI collapses days of takeoff into hours, and clients have bid 50% more with smaller estimating teams.Backed by Khosla Ventures (YC W25).
current.description: Bild AI reads construction blueprints and extracts material and cost data for builders/suppliers. Backed by the same investors as Plangrid, Dropbox, & Airbnb
current.name: Bild AI
current.title: Co-Founder
